chunks: ʿAlī, from Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Abī ʿAbdillāh al-Muʾmin, from Abī Hirāsah, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
If the Imam were to be raised from the earth for an hour, it would surge with its inhabitants just as the sea surges with its inhabitants.

key_terms.الْأَرْضِ: the earth, the worldly realm inhabited by creation
key_terms.الْإِمَامَ: the Imam, the divinely appointed leader and proof of Allah upon creation
key_terms.الْبَحْرُ: the sea, used here as a simile for violent motion
key_terms.سَاعَةً: for a moment or brief period
key_terms.لَمَاجَتْ: it would become turbulent and violently disturbed

ai.seo_question: Why can the earth never be without an Imam in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith affirms the necessity of the continuous presence of the Imam as the Divine Authority upon the earth. It presents the Imam as a source of existential stability, without whom the earth and its inhabitants would fall into turmoil.
